fullDescription: A brutalist Swiss-print pricing page on warm paper stock with hairline ink rules, one electric red accent, an inverted recommended tier, a monthly/yearly toggle, and a full feature-comparison matrix.
prompt:
## Resumo
A Swiss-editorial / brutalist SaaS pricing page on warm off-white paper stock with hard ink-black hairline rules, a single electric red-orange accent, and a typographic system mixing a heavy grotesk, a condensed narrow sans, and a mono label face. The whole page is built on a frameless, fully-ruled 4-column tier grid (one dark inverted 'Most picked' card) plus a full feature-comparison matrix, an editorial FAQ, and a red full-bleed CTA strip. The transferable value is this exact print-magazine look applied to a 4-tier + monthly/yearly-toggle + comparison-table pricing structure.

## Estilo Visual
Use a flat editorial Swiss-print palette: page/paper background #f4f1ea (secondary panel #efeae0), ink (text + all borders) #16140f, muted 'smoke' text #6b665c, accent red #e8341c with a darker hover red #c22310. Selection highlight is red bg on paper text. Type system: headings + prices in 'Archivo' grotesk at heavy weights (800/900) with tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.03em) and very tight leading (~0.9) for the hero; body and feature copy in 'Archivo Narrow' (condensed) at 13-18px; all micro-labels, eyebrows, metadata and footer in 'Space Mono' uppercase, 10-11px, with wide letter-spacing (0.18em-0.26em). Borders are crisp 1px ink hairlines (lighter ink/15 inside tables/FAQ); zero border-radius anywhere; no shadows; no gradients. Numbers use tabular-nums. Add a subtle multiply-blend fractal-noise grain (~4.5% opacity) only behind the hero. Antialiased, optimizeLegibility.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
Sticky top header (z-50) with a translucent paper background (paper/95) + backdrop-blur and a bottom ink hairline. 64px tall, inside the 1280px container. Left: a 28px solid-red square icon tile (slash/forward-box glyph in paper), the wordmark 'Promptsmith' in heavy grotesk (~18px, 800), and a mono micro-tag 'PROMPT LIBRARY' (hidden on mobile). Center (desktop only): nav links Library / Components / Pricing / Docs / Changelog in condensed narrow uppercase 13px, the active 'Pricing' colored red, others hover-to-red. Right: a ghost 'Sign in' text link and a solid ink 'Start free' button (paper text, hovers to red). All flat, no radius.

### Hero + stats ticker
Hero band with the noise-grain overlay and a bottom ink hairline. 12-column grid, items aligned to the baseline. Left 8 cols: a mono eyebrow '001 - Pricing' in red next to a thin horizontal rule, then a giant grotesk 900 headline 'Ship UI from a prompt.' with 'prompt.' in red, leading ~0.9, tracking -0.03em, scaling 44px -> 64px -> 92px. Right 4 cols: a short condensed-narrow support paragraph (~16-18px, ink/80, max ~34ch) describing the curated prompt library. Below the hero, a full-width ticker row divided into 4 mono uppercase cells separated by vertical hairlines: '12,400+ prompts', 'Infinite canvas', 'No card to start', 'Cancel anytime' (last cell hidden on mobile).

### Billing toggle bar
Thin full-width band with a bottom ink hairline. Left: mono uppercase metadata 'PLANS / PER EDITOR / USD'. Right: a 'Monthly' label, a custom square toggle (56x28px, 1px ink border, paper fill, a 22px solid-red square knob that slides right when active), a bolder 'Yearly' label, and a small solid-ink 'SAVE 20%' mono chip. Toggling swaps the displayed prices and the billed-amount subline on the paid tiers via JS.

### Pricing grid (4 tiers)
The core: a frameless 4-column tier grid inside the container, columns separated by vertical ink hairlines (lg:divide-x), bounded top and bottom by the section hairlines. Reflows to 2 columns on tablet and 1 column (stacked, with horizontal hairlines between cards) on mobile. Four tiers: Hobby ($0/mo, 'free forever'), Pro ($16/mo, highlighted), Team ($39/mo), Studio (Custom, 'let's talk volume'). Each card: a top row with the tier name in heavy grotesk (22px, 800) and a mono index number (00/01/02/03) right-aligned; a one-line condensed-narrow descriptor (smoke, ~28ch); a big grotesk-900 price (52px, tabular-nums) with a small mono '/mo' suffix and a mono billed-amount subline; a full-width CTA button; then a checklist of 4 features in condensed narrow with red check icons (an unavailable item uses a muted close/x icon). The PRO card is inverted: solid ink background, paper text, a small absolute red 'MOST PICKED' tab pinned to its top-right corner, a solid-red 'Get Pro' button, and a red billed-yearly subline; it sits at z-10. The other cards use ghost outline buttons (1px ink, hover fills ink). Hobby CTA 'Start free', Team 'Start trial', Studio 'Contact sales'.

### Comparison table (feature matrix)
A 'Compare every plan' section: heading in grotesk 900 on the left with a mono 'FULL FEATURE MATRIX' label on the right. Below, a full feature-comparison table (min-width ~680px, scrolls horizontally on mobile inside an overflow-x container). First column is the feature name (~40% width, condensed narrow), followed by 4 centered plan columns (Hobby / Pro / Team / Studio) with heavy-grotesk headers; the Pro column is emphasized with a faint ink/4% tint running down the whole column and a 3px red top border on its header cell. Rows are grouped under mono red uppercase subheads (Library / Canvas / Collaboration / Support) and separated by light ink/15 hairlines. Cells show tabular-num values ('50', 'Unlimited', 'All 140', '1', '10'), text values ('Community', 'Email', 'Priority', 'Dedicated'), red check icons for included, and a muted minus icon for excluded.

### FAQ
Editorial FAQ on a 12-column grid. Left 4 cols: heading 'Questions, answered.' in grotesk 900 with tight leading, plus a warm condensed-narrow line ('Still stuck? Ping us and we'll sort it together.'). Right 8 cols: a definition list with top + dividing ink/15 hairlines; each item is a row where the question (grotesk 700, ~16px) sits in the left 4 sub-columns and the answer (condensed narrow, ink/75, relaxed leading) in the right 8 sub-columns. 4 Q&As covering prompt copies, switching plans, no-card-to-start, and the coding-agent skill.

### CTA strip + footer
Full-bleed solid-red CTA band (paper text, ink bottom hairline): a big grotesk-900 line 'Your next screen is one prompt away.' (32 -> 56px, leading ~0.92) on the left and a solid-paper 'Start free' button with a top-right arrow on the right (hovers to ink). Footer on paper: a 2 -> 5 column grid with the red-tile brand lockup + tagline spanning 2 cols, then Product / Company / Legal link columns under mono uppercase headings; a bottom hairline row with mono copyright ('(c) 2026 Promptsmith Labs') and a mono tagline ('Made on an infinite canvas').

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Inverted highlighted tier card — The Pro plan card flips to a solid ink-black background with paper text to anchor the eye, with a small red corner tab labelling it the recommended plan.
Make the recommended pricing card a solid ink (#16140f) block with paper (#f4f1ea) text, raised on z-10. Pin a small absolute red (#e8341c) tab to its top-right reading 'MOST PICKED' in mono uppercase. Use a solid-red primary button inside it (vs ghost outline buttons on the neutral cards), tint its descriptor and price-suffix text to paper/60-65%, and color its billed-amount subline red.

### Square hard-edged billing toggle — A monthly/yearly switch built as a flat square (not a pill) with a sliding solid-red square knob, matching the brutalist no-radius system.
Build a 56x28px toggle with a 1px ink border and paper fill, containing a 22px solid-red square knob (2px inset) that translateX(28px) when yearly is active (200ms transition). Pair it with 'Monthly' / 'Yearly' condensed-narrow labels and a solid-ink 'SAVE 20%' mono chip. On toggle, JS rewrites the [data-price] price text and [data-sub] billed-amount sublines on the paid tiers.

### Mono editorial labels / index numbers — Space Mono uppercase micro-labels with very wide tracking used as section eyebrows ('001 - Pricing'), tier index numbers (00-03), table group headers, and ticker/footer metadata, giving the page its print-catalogue feel.
Throughout, use Space Mono uppercase at 10-11px with 0.18em-0.26em letter-spacing in smoke or red for all eyebrows, per-tier index numbers, the stats ticker, table section subheads, and footer metadata. Keep them small and quiet so the grotesk headlines dominate.

### Tinted recommended column in the matrix — The Pro column in the comparison table is continuously emphasized with a faint tint and a red top border so the highlighted plan reads consistently from the cards into the table.
In the comparison table, apply a faint ink/4% background tint to every cell of the Pro column (header through last row) and a 3px solid-red top border on the Pro header cell, so the recommended plan stays visually emphasized down the whole matrix.

## Notas Especiais
Frameless, fully responsive web page (not a fixed frame): a 1280px max-width container with px-6/lg:px-10 side padding; content is a vertical stack of full-width bands separated by 1px ink hairlines, with a STICKY translucent+blurred top nav. The pricing grid reflows 4 -> 2 -> 1 columns and the comparison table scrolls horizontally on mobile inside an overflow-x wrapper. Strictly no border-radius, no shadows, no gradients - the structure is carried entirely by hairline rules, the inverted card, and the single red accent. Fonts: Archivo (grotesk), Archivo Narrow (condensed), Space Mono. Brand voice in copy is warm and human (e.g. 'Ping us and we'll sort it together'), no em-dashes.

Hairline 1px ink rules divide everything; no rounded corners, no drop shadows, no gradients. Mono micro-labels with wide letter-spacing act as editorial section numbers/eyebrows. A faint fractal-noise grain overlay sits on the hero for a printed-paper texture. Tabular-nums on all prices and numeric table cells.
